authorityClaim: g30-fixture-corpus.v1 PROPOSES leftover-design fixture implementations for occupancy v2's three named corpus classes and seven live retained-evidence members. The warrant is D-293 Decision 8 (adoption commit c10319d207cb90e2bf9df4c5e5997cfd35a30193) and D-316 (Class A opening for DR-117; G29/G30 authoring sequenced after that opening). Each positive fixture is a five-element JSON array quoting g30-input-corpus.v1 id, occupancy class id, occupancy retainedEvidence id, memberVerbatim, and that member's exactByteIntent first clause. Each not-that-gate fixture is a four-element JSON array quoting occupancy retainedEvidence id EV-5, EV-6, or EV-7, the occupancy not-that-gate distinction phrase, memberVerbatim, and that member's exactByteIntent first clause. EV-1 and EV-2 quote distinct retainedEvidence exactByteIntent first clauses so the two EE-7a limbs are not collapsed. EE-7b quotes the recorded PlanIntent-or-release disjunction and does not invent a PlanIntent schema. The advertisement text is occupancy exactByteIntent prose, not an invented field schema. The future DR-131 pack is named as a selected limb in the quoted EV-1 exactByteIntent and is not authored. Platforms are quoted from occupancy v2 #$.platforms as a later copy axis, not as a live-cell member; g30-fixture-corpus.v1 does not invent a D-002 platform list, does not copy onto Windows, and does not author per-platform copies. The flat fixtures/g30.v1/ directory follows g21-fixture-corpus.v1 first-authoring. Not this artifact's version number relative to g21-fixture-corpus.v1. It does not invent FX/AT/NT/G30-* fixture identifiers. It does not invent a D9 code, exit number, HostTermination, or section 7.1 recipe. It does not mint Rust-as-core. It does not name G13 into required-now. It does not take over DR-101, G13, G14, G16, G24, or G29. It does not close leftover-design of OBL-G30-FX-AUTHORING. It does not remasure leftover-join.v4. It does not SATISFY DR-117. It does not SATISFY DR-131. It applies nothing and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/.
